<title level="1" right="Action">[Poisonous Sweep](/Actions.aspx?ID=2787) <actions string="Single Action" /></title>

<traits>
<trait label="Flourish" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=606" />
<trait label="Poison" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=669" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 92

</column>

---

The salamander secretes poison from the glands on its tail and bludgeons an enemy to apply it to them. It makes a tail Strike. If the Strike hits, the target takes an additional 1d6 [persistent poison damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86). If your salamander is [nimble](/AnimalCompanions.aspx?ID=7&Advanced=true) or [savage](/AnimalCompanions.aspx?ID=8&Advanced=true), increase this damage to 2d6 persistent poison damage.
name: Poisonous Sweep
